Claim amendment · #35440 · 2026-11-20T06:02Z

File surface (amended): adds `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/user-ban-write.ts` (`engineUserBanWriter`), for one change only: its `sys_user` write takes the admin's attribution through the existing `authSystemWriteContext()` seam, as the sibling admin writes do (`admin-user-endpoints.ts`, `admin-set-user-manager.ts`). Reason: os-dev-report 7031844902 measured that on a kernel without the vendor admin plugin the ban write runs with no `attributedUserId`, so plugin-audit's mirror row records a ban as the system, while with the admin plugin the same write names the admin. Same operation, two implementations, the attributed one wins (SKILL.md 〈升级与决策〉 meta-rule ②). It rides PR #35758 as a patch round so the card's "ban actions findable in the admin audit" lands whole. No ban write field changes (the 2026-08-18 ruling stands).
